title: Aromatic Braised Slovakian Onion Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring caramelized red onions in a mediterranean-inspired brine, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onions and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the caraway seeds, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour in the red wine vinegar and water, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the onions are soft and the liquid has reduced.
Stir in the chopped feta cheese and cook for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the stew to a serving dish and garnish with fresh parsley.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
